scripts.build: npm run build:npm && npm run build:web && npm run build:ffi
scripts.build:web: cd portable-xstate-wasm && wasm-pack build --target web --out-name portable_xstate
scripts.build:npm: cd portable-xstate-wasm && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg-npm --out-name portable_xstate
scripts.test: npm run test:native && npm run test:wasm && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:ffi && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:ffi: npm run build:ffi && npm run test:ffi:c && npm run test:ffi:cpp
scripts.test:ffi:c: mkdir -p portable-xstate-ffi/tests/out && clang portable-xstate-ffi/tests/c_test.c -o portable-xstate-ffi/tests/out/c_test -I portable-xstate-ffi/include -L target/debug -lportable_xstate_ffi && ./portable-xstate-ffi/tests/out/c_test
scripts.test:ffi:cpp: mkdir -p portable-xstate-ffi/tests/out && clang++ portable-xstate-ffi/tests/cpp_test.cpp -o portable-xstate-ffi/tests/out/cpp_test -I portable-xstate-ffi/include -L target/debug -lportable_xstate_ffi -std=c++11 && ./portable-xstate-ffi/tests/out/cpp_test
